headline: Vote on recommending approval of the FY 2027 Amended Budget, and discussion of the 5-Year Budget Projection.
summary: The group will vote on whether to recommend the FY 2027 Amended Budget to the full committee. It will also discuss the 5-Year Budget Projection.
items: Vote to recommend to the full committee the approval of the FY 2027 Amended Budget
location: Springfield City Hall, 36 Court Street 2 FLR, Room 220, Springfield, MA
